title: Director of Business Development at Delta Electronics, Inc. Believes Asia Vital Components Is Gaining Data-Center Cooling Share
expert: Director of Business Development at Delta Electronics (thermal competitor); sees AVC in direct OEM bids
verdict: Delta beat AVC in a hyperscaler air-cooling bid ~6 months ago (first-hand), yet the expert sees AVC gaining share to a solid #3 with ~15% of data-center cooling and leading on Vera Rubin cold plates.

Nvidia content and share: 🟢 ~15% of data-center cooling, solid #3 near #2 (estimate), first read on overall share.
🔴 Auras over 10% cold-plate share (hearsay) vs 5–10% (SB #64467), matching the 2026-11-06 nVent call. → Tenet 1 (Rubin content and share) ↓
Rubin yield and ramp: 🟢 Rubin cold-plate yield 60–70% to 80% (hearsay), same as the 2026-11-06 calls, vs ~60% in May (SB #64479).
Gross margin: 🔴 Standardization price erosion of 10% or 15% (estimate) vs high-single-digit a year in the 2026-11-06 nVent call. → Tenet 3 (GM 34%+) ↓
ASIC liquid-cooling start: ⚪ Custom ASICs 35–40% of 2027 accelerator liquid-cooling volume (estimate), first read. → Tenet 2 (ASIC >50% of liquid revenue) →

changes: Auras >10% cold-plate share vs 5-10% (SB #64467); same as 2026-11-06 nVent call: confirming Auras gains.
Rubin yield 80% matches the 2026-11-06 calls; vs ~60% in May (SB #64479).
Standardization price erosion 10% or 15% vs high-single-digit a year in the 2026-11-06 nVent call: same direction.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (Rubin content and share): → — AVC gaining overall (~15%, #3) but Auras >10% in cold plates and a lost Delta bid.
Tenet 2 (ASIC >50% of liquid revenue): → — ASICs 35-40% of 2027 accelerator liquid volume (industry, not AVC mix).
Tenet 3 (GM 34%+): ↓ — 10-15% standardization erosion, partly offset by the yield gain.
